verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, a CLI and team-scoped API keys for managing resources such as machines. Nothing in the pack shows a usage or billing endpoint, cost breakdowns, or a way to attribute GPU spend by team or workload. Generic resource-management APIs are building blocks, not the billing-attribution capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload
